name: @terpjs/eslint-boundaries
description: Terp frontend boundary rules (as data) + the ESLint adapter, over all app source under src/: no cross-module imports, no package internals, component-scoped CSS Modules and a shared token pipeline, token-styled components for raw HTML tags, router-only in-app links, generated-client-only, and browser XSS/navigation sink bans. Strict-only (no modes); governed opt-outs via terp-allow markers + the escape-hatch budget ratchet (terp-boundaries-budget).
